cv.title: Curriculum vitae
cv.aboutDescription: Software Engineering graduate, specialized in backend development with Java and Spring Boot. I have experience developing REST APIs for projects in different fields, including healthcare, project management, and distributed systems for the Internet of Things. Additionally, I have experience with data persistence using Hibernate/JPA, SQL databases, Docker, implementation of SOLID principles, software design, testing, and backend system deployment.

vidaRosa.bullet1: Completely redesigned and refactored the backend architecture and implementation to adapt it as a data collection tool, carrying out a software engineering process that included planning, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
vidaRosa.bullet2: Ensured reliable data collection, with more than 80 records processed by the REST API and successfully stored in a PostgreSQL database, through a preparation and validation of the backend, anticipating incorrect data-entry scenarios.
vidaRosa.bullet3: Achieved a 100% test success rate and an average code coverage of 92.1% across the microservices, by designing and executing more than 250 unit tests and integration tests, with results analyzed using Allure Report and SonarQube.
vidaRosa.bullet4: Strengthened backend reliability and reduced coupling by designing and implementing a validation architecture in a new layer, focused on facilitating validation extension and reuse.
vidaRosa.bullet5: Improved code quality, achieving an analysis with no pending findings in SonarQube by resolving the detected issues.
vidaRosa.bullet6: Deployed the system to production, fully configuring a VPS with HTTPS, a firewall, NGINX and backend deployment with Docker and Docker Hub.

greenhouse.title: IoT Greenhouse System
greenhouse.bullet1: Avoided code duplication and simplified the extension of sensors and actuators by designing a class hierarchy that reuses common attributes and behaviors, as well as by applying the Factory Method pattern.
greenhouse.bullet2: Standardized a communication strategy to enable dynamic control and accurate device feedback, by defining specific MQTT topics for commands, data, mode and status, together with its implementation in code.

criticalPath.title: Critical Path Method Calculation Application
criticalPath.bullet1: Prevented implementation errors by designing the technical foundation of the system before coding, including: the software architecture, use cases, backend REST API and data model.
criticalPath.bullet2: Implemented the complete backend solution using Java, Spring Boot and Hibernate for the REST API and PostgreSQL for the database.
criticalPath.bullet3: Avoided unnecessary storage in database, by persisting the textual sequence of the critical path and generating its diagram on demand from the backend.
